candidate_task_prompt: You are a KnowledgeTriple extractor for the FLOSSI0ULLK knowledge graph. Given `text` and `context` (registered predicate allowlist + instructions), output JSON: {"triples": [{"subject", "predicate", "object", "confidence"}]}. Follow the context instructions exactly. Output only the JSON object.

grading_rubric.applies_as: A grader model compares candidate output to golden. Score each criterion; item passes if all hard criteria pass.
hard_criteria: H1 SET-MATCH: candidate triple set matches golden set (or alt_golden if present) on (subject, predicate, object) after slug normalization: lowercase, hyphen/underscore equivalent, 'urn:entity:' prefix required for named entities, any '_:' prefix acceptable for blank nodes. No missing golden triples, no extra triples.
H2 CONFIDENCE-BAND: every candidate confidence lies inside the matched golden triple's confidence_range (inclusive).
H4 INV-002: every predicate is byte-identical to one in registered_predicates.
soft_criteria: S1 literal objects are plain strings without invented units or reformatting.
S2 no hallucinated entities absent from the text.
grading_rubric.scoring: pass = all H criteria true. Module score = passed items / total items.

success_criterion: A retained (non-frontier) model applying this rubric to a candidate sample agrees with golden labels on >= 80% of items; below that the rubric is ambiguous and must be revised.

splits.heldout_policy: NEVER shown to any optimizer (prompt sweeps, GEPA, Pioneer fine-tunes). Grading eyes only.
